name: Maze-Bench-v0.2
description: Maze-Bench-v0.2 provides a set of maze-solving/navigation tasks designed to evaluate autonomous agents' planning and sequential decision-making abilities in simulated environments. Tasks vary in maze size and complexity and typically require mapping, long-horizon planning, and execution robustness. The benchmark is intended for embodied/agent research and can be used to compare planners, RL agents, and language-guided controllers.
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face and used by a niche community working on embodied agents and planning; adoption is growing but still specialized.
